description: Show a per-model breakdown of your token usage across all platforms detected by tokscale. Models under the threshold (default 1%) are lumped into 'other' to keep the display clean. Useful for seeing which models you actually use per platform (e.g. claude-opus-4-8 76%, claude-sonnet-4-6 11%, other 0.3%). Returns { platform: [{ model, input, output, cacheRead, cacheCreate, pct }] }.

threshold.description: Models below this fraction of their platform's total tokens are lumped into 'other'. Default 0.01 (1%). Set 0 to see every model.

name: tokscale_breakdown

platforms.description: Map of platform name → array of { model, input, output, cacheRead, cacheCreate, pct }
